strategies.name: Detection of System Binary Proxy Execution

analytics.name: Analytic 1925
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a trusted, signed Windows system binary executing with command-line arguments inconsistent with its documented administrative purpose -- specifically arguments indicating payload decoding, remote content execution, or script invocation -- on an Industrial Control System (ICS) host. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

tuning.description: Inventory of ICS hosts warranting this elevated monitoring.
Documented command-line argument patterns for living-off-the-land binary abuse.

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
log_sources.channel: EventCode=1 image matches certutil.exe/regsvr32.exe/mshta.exe/rundll32.exe and command line matches Living-off-the-Land Binary (LOLBin) abuse patterns on host in Industrial Control Systems (ICS) workstation inventory

analytics.name: Analytic 2152
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies system binaries (bash, python, perl, awk, dd) on Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux assets executing with arguments that pipe or decode external content rather than performing their documented administrative function. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

tuning.description: Inventory of ICS hosts warranting this elevated monitoring.
Documented command-line argument patterns for living-off-the-land binary abuse.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): system binary executing with command line piping or decoding external content, from Industrial Control Systems (ICS) service account User Identifier (UID)

analytics.name: Analytic 2242
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol messages using embedded device built-in utilities or vendor-supplied diagnostic tools to execute payloads, from sources not in the approved engineering workstation list, containing payloads inconsistent with legitimate diagnostic use. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
